steps.name: clear-while-held
steps.dialogText:
Clear this customer's profile details

Clearing a profile erases what a privacy deletion erases, so it needs a different owner's approval: this records the request, and a second owner approves it on Approvals. The console cannot restore these details afterwards. Check the name and ID below belong to the customer you mean.

Customer

Phone

What happens

Removed: name, email, phone number, gender and push token.
Kept: sign-in identity, bookings, invoices and messages.
The audit log records who asked, who approved and why, but not the values that were removed.
Reason (recorded in the audit log)

Recorded in the audit log with your name.

steps.refusal: A legal hold keeps this customer's account, so the profile cannot be cleared. Nothing was changed; the hold must be released first on Privacy Requests.
